subject: POC Observability: trial gating, dashboards & ownership (OmniFin)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@omnifin.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@omnifin.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Observability: trial gating, dashboards & ownership (OmniFin)

Hi Samantha / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to iterate from. High-level scope: a 3-week trial to validate Redwood inference for OmniFin's real-time document ingestion pipeline focusing on reliability and performance observability.

Primary objectives (proposed):
- Success gate 1: 99th percentile request latency across typical batch sizes < 300ms end-to-end (ingest -> model response).
- Success gate 2: Model fallback rate (forced-downmodels/variants) < 1% during test window.
- Success gate 3: KV/prefix cache hit ratio > 70% for repeated request patterns.
- Success gate 4: No PII exfil incidents and logs exported to your SOC pipeline (S3/GCS) for audit.

POC plan (draft):
- Week 0 (prep): access + data subset, KMS details for logs if required, baseline traffic replay.
- Week 1: baseline runs + initial dashboarding (latency, throughput, errors, cache hits).
- Week 2: stress cases (burst + long-context) + trace collection and tail-latency analysis.
- Week 3: stabilization, final readout, and success gating decision.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Jordan Blake (dashboards/metrics), Karthik Iyer (traces/log export + runtime config), Tessa Morgan (eng/sales coordination).
- OmniFin: Samantha (product), Rajiv (platform).

Attachments: omnifin-poc-checklist-v1.pdf (high-level checklist), observability-dashboard-template.json (example panels).

Asks for you: please confirm these success gates, and whether the proposed timeline (kickoff week of Sep 25) works. If you want different gating thresholds we'll adjust — this is intended to align on measurable pass/fail criteria before we start.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | https://redwoodinference.com
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@omnifin.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@omnifin.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Sep 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability: trial gating, dashboards & ownership (OmniFin)

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Overall this looks good and I appreciate the measurable gates. Two small items from our side:
1) Can we tighten the latency gate to 99th < 250ms if feasible? That reflects a hard SLA for our front-end experience.
2) For logs export, we need them delivered to an S3 bucket in our account with lifecycle policies (we will provide the bucket ARN).

Kickoff week of Sep 25 works for us — Rajiv and I can do a 60-minute kickoff on Tue Sep 26 in the morning (PDT).

Also attaching an internal doc with our security checklist (see trial-reqs.xlsx) — legal will follow up on KMS/contract language but not blocking kickoff.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Dir, Product — OmniFin
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@omnifin.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@omnifin.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Sep 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability: trial gating, dashboards & ownership (OmniFin)

Samantha —

Thanks, we can target 99th < 250ms as an aspirational gate and will log that separately as a stretch metric. For the S3 export we’ll coordinate with Rajiv on the bucket ARN and a short checklist for bucket policies — noted that legal will follow up.

Updated asks and owners:
- Jordan: build Grafana dashboard (see attached observability-dashboard-template.json) and a one-page screenshot we can share at kickoff. ETA: 2 business days post-kickoff for initial dashboard.
- Karthik: configure traces and log export; validate the S3 delivery + IAM role. ETA: end of Week 0 (pre-kickoff).
- Marissa: CS/onboarding lead for trial runbooks and acceptance walkthrough.

I’ve updated the checklist (attached) with the S3/KMS rows and a pre-kickoff runbook link. HubSpot deal attached: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/OMN-4592 — please confirm when you’ve added the bucket ARN so we can request IAM.

If that looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff for Tue Sep 26 09:30am PDT.

Thanks,
Tessa
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability: trial gating, dashboards & ownership (OmniFin)

Quick internal note and commitment: I’ll own the dashboard work for the trial. Plan:
- Template: use observability-dashboard-template.json as starting point.
- Panels: token throughput (TPS), 50/95/99 latency, tail-percentile breakdown by model variant, model fallback rate, cache hit ratio, error types, request distribution by route.
- Alerting: create perf alerts for 99th latency > 300ms (informational), fallback rate > 2% (critical).

ETA: initial dashboard + screenshot within 48 hours post-kickoff. Will merge in any OmniFin-specific panels after the first baseline run.

Jordan
Sr. Observability Engineer | Redwood Inference
